setup:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(2)
n = 2000
k = rng.integers(0, 4, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 8, (4, 3))
xyz = centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 3))
df = pd.DataFrame({'umap_x': xyz[:, 0], 'umap_y': xyz[:, 1], 'umap_z': xyz[:, 2], 'score': rng.normal(size=n), 'group': [f'g{v}' for v in k]})

steps.name: switch to columns mode — auto-detects umap_x/y/z
run prepare and wait for 3D layout
steps.report: { phase: a.phase, dims: a.dims, nKept: a.nKept, allXYLen: a.allXY ? a.allXY.length : null }

steps.name: color by group
steps.report: { colorColumn: a.colorColumn, categories: a.colorMeta ? a.colorMeta.categories.length : null }

steps.name: wait for 3D screen positions to be computed
hover at anchor 0 screen position shows tooltip
steps.eval: const sx = a._3dScreenXY[0], sy = a._3dScreenXY[1]; a.onPointer({ x: sx, y: sy, world: [0, 0] })

steps.name: switch back to UMAP mode clears 3D coords
